reader.requirement: At --std 85 the first GENERATE for a report saves the control values; later GENERATEs compare against that saved set until a break, and at a break the new set is saved and used for later tests.

edition-consulted.switches: bakes ctx.Data.DialectLevel into CobolReport.Edition, the argument every DialectBehaviors.IsActive question of the engine is asked with; the CONTROL registration (AddControl order, FINAL, image/float/collated arms) is edition-independent

reader.edition-search: the Prior assignment at the first GENERATE and the Prior = current[i] renewal after the footings take no edition (grep Edition/IsActive in GenerateCore's break arm)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf35_02; two value changes between GENERATEs, a break renewing the saved set and a first GENERATE of the report-name form were probed

probes.printed: CONTROLS K1 (group) K2 (S999 COMP-3) K3 (S9V9): G1 CH1 CH2 CH3 DE; minor change CF3 CH3 DE; intermediate CF3 CF2 CH2 CH3 DE; group-subfield change CF3 CF2 CF1 CH1 CH2 CH3 DE; no change DE only; K2 -1 and -999/-9.9 extremes break at K2; two moves between GENERATEs compared against the saved set only; CF USE procedures see prior values, CH/DE current; TERMINATE CF3 CF2 CF1
probes.expected: §1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR1/GR2, §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR3/GR6: highest changed level, CFs minor to major, CHs major to minor, saved set renewed at each break

probes.printed: R (FINAL K): first GENERATE R prints CHF, CHK +0 (saves); K=1 GENERATE R: CFK 0, CHK +1; GENERATE DTL: DE +1, no break; report S: a change sensed by GENERATE of a different detail SD2 (SCF A, SCH B, SD2 B); +0 to -0 sensed as a break (CFK 0, CHK -0) while IF K = 0 is true
probes.expected: breaks as derived; no break between +0 and -0 (§1985:XIII.3.7.4 GR3 a, numeric comparison)

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR3  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3

reader.notes: c.Prior = c.Get() at the first GENERATE; Prior renewed from the saved current values after the CF phase; probes G9/G10 show the test is against the saved set, not the last moved value. The -0/+0 comparison defect (PB5782) is the comparison class, not the saving this rule states.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR3 and ReportWriter.cs GenerateCore (Prior = Get() at the first GENERATE; Prior = current[i] after the CF phase) and Initiate (Prior = null). The USE-procedure attack (a CH procedure changing a control item after the save) is closed by §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR4 (OK  §1985:XIII.4.9.3 SR4) 'A USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure must not alter the value of any control data item'. Probe r3two at --std 85: two reports R and S on one file with the SAME control item K; each report keeps its own saved set (first GENERATE SDT at K=2 saves 2 for S without a break; R breaks RCF 1 then RCF 2; S later SCF 2); TERMINATE R then INITIATE R: the next first GENERATE saves afresh (RDT 5 twice, no break), TERMINATE R S gives RCF 5 and SCF 3 (S's own prior). The -0/+0 defect is the comparison class (kept on 3.7.4-2/3, PB5782), not the save/renew this rule states. cite: OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR3  (4.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3.
